id: 第二章-善恶篇-杜子春-五-p1

en: 第二章-善恶篇-杜子春-五
Toshishun's body lay face-up on the rocks, but his soul had already left it and was falling into the depths of hell.
u.src: 杜子春的身体仰躺在岩石上，但灵魂却已出窍，坠向地狱的深渊。

en: First, there is a passage between the real world and hell called the Dark Cavern Road,
u.src: 现在先说，现实世界和地狱之间有一条通道，叫暗穴道，

en: there the sky and earth are dim all year round, and a fierce wind cuts to the bone.
u.src: 那是常年天地昏暗，疾风刺骨。

en: Du Zichun was swept along by the cold wind, drifting through the air like a rootless fallen leaf,
u.src: 杜子春被寒风裹挟而行，像无根的落叶飘荡在空中，

en: and before long he arrived before a magnificent and splendid great hall,
u.src: 不多儿，就来到了一座富丽堂皇的大殿跟前，

en: and on the plaque hanging in the center of the hall were written the three large characters, "Hall of King Yama."
u.src: 大殿正中悬挂的牌匾上写了“阎罗殿”三个大字。

en: Many demon guards were waiting in front of the hall. When they saw Toshishun, they immediately came forward, bound him, and forced him down before the high steps.
u.src: 众多鬼卒在殿前候着，看着杜子春，立马上来将他困住，按倒在高阶前面。

en: On the high steps stood a solemn and majestic king. He wore a black robe and a golden crown, and was looking down on everyone with contempt. This had to be King Yama, whom Toshishun had so often heard people speak of before.
u.src: 高阶上有一位威严肃穆的大王，那人身着黑袍，头戴金冠，正睥睨众人，这人想必就是以前常听人说的阎罗王。

en: Toshishun knelt on the ground in terror, not knowing what he would have to go through next.
u.src: 杜子春提心吊胆的跪在地上，不知道还要经历什么遭遇。

en: Why are you sitting upright on Mount Emei?
u.src: 你为什么端坐在峨眉山上？”

en: From above the steps came the voice of King Yama, loud as thunder.
u.src: 阶上传来阎罗王的声音，声大如雷。

en: Du Zichun anxiously tried to answer, but suddenly remembered Tieguanzi's warning to remain silent, so he merely lowered his head without speaking, as if he were mute.
u.src: 杜子春慌慌张张想要回话，突然想起铁冠子的嘱托“缄默不言”，于是他只是低头不语，像是哑巴一样。

en: King Yama raised his hand and lifted the iron tablet he held; his beard bristled across his face as he roared with a terrifying glare:
u.src: 阎罗王抬手举起手里的铁笏板，髭须倒竖在脸上，凶神恶煞地叱道：

en: Where do you think you are right now?
u.src: “你觉得你现在是在什么地方？

ja: をすればそれでよいが、もし
en: If you answer quickly, that will be the end of it; but if you remain stubborn, this king will immediately make you learn what the punishments of hell are like!
u.src: 你要是快点回话也就算了，如果顽固不化，本王立刻让你体会下地狱的刑罚是什么样子！”

en: But Toshishun remained just as he was, without even moving his lips.
u.src: 但是，杜子春仍旧如故，嘴唇动也不动。

en: Seeing this, King Yama spoke a few fierce words to the demon guards. The guards answered with a cry, then immediately seized Toshishun and flew upward toward the hall of King Yama.
u.src: 阎罗王见这情景，对着鬼卒们恶狠狠的说了几句，鬼卒们应了一生，马上押着杜子春往阎王殿上方飞去。

en: As everyone knows, hell contains not only mountains of blades and pools of blood, but beneath its sunless sky there are also the flaming valley of the sea of fire and the icy sea of the freezing hell, which are spoken of alongside them.
u.src: 大家都知道，地狱里面不光有刀山血池，在暗无天日的天空下，还有火海地狱火焰谷、极寒地狱冰海与它并称。

en: The demon guards threw Toshishun into each of these hells one after another,
u.src: 鬼卒们把杜子春逐一扔进这些地狱里，

en: Toshishun had his chest pierced by blades, his face burned by flames, his skin flayed and his tongue pulled out,
u.src: 杜子春被刀穿胸，被火焰烧脸，被拨皮拔舌，

en: he was beaten with iron pestles, tormented in cauldrons of oil, had his brain bitten by venomous snakes, and had his eyes gouged out by hawks and bears—
u.src: 被铁杵棒打，被油锅煎熬，被毒蛇噬脑、被鹰熊挖眼——

en: he suffered every one of these cruel tortures in turn.
u.src: 这些酷刑一一遭受了一个遍。

en: As for the pain in all of this, it was truly beyond words.
u.src: 如果说这其中的痛苦，那真是难以言表。

en: Even so, Toshishun still stubbornly clenched his teeth and remained silent.
u.src: 就算是这样，杜子春依然顽强的绷紧牙关，缄默不言。

en: In the end, even the demon guards were at a loss,
u.src: 到了最后，鬼卒们也无计可施，

en: they could only fly up once more into the sunless dark sky,
u.src: 他们只能再次飞上暗无天日的天空，

en: returned to the Hall of King Yama, and just as before forced Duzichun down before the steps,
u.src: 回到阎罗殿，就像刚才一样将杜子春按倒在阶前，

en: and reported in one voice to King Yama seated in the hall:
u.src: 并齐声向阎罗殿上阎罗王汇报：

ja: くつもりがないようだ
en: From the look of it now, this criminal really has no intention of opening his mouth.
u.src: “现在看来，这个罪犯真的是不打算开口了”

en: King Yama furrowed his brow and thought for a while; then, as if he had come up with a good idea, he said to one of the demon guards:
u.src: 阎罗王蹙起眉头，想了想，似乎想到什么好办法，对一个鬼卒说：

en: "This man's parents have now fallen into the realm of beasts. Go quickly and bring them to the hall."
u.src: “这个人的父母现在已堕入畜生道，速去把它们带到殿上来。”

en: The demon guard at once rode the wind up into the sky over hell, and in an instant led down two beasts, landing like lightning before King Yama's hall.
u.src: 鬼卒马上乘风飞到地狱的天上，一瞬间就牵着两头牲畜，闪电般落在阎罗殿前。

en: When Tu Zichun saw those two beasts, he was frightened beyond belief,
u.src: 看到那两头牲畜，杜子春吓得难以置信，

en: because although they were only two pitifully thin horses,
u.src: 因为那虽然只是两批瘦的可怜的马，

en: but their faces were unmistakably those of his dead parents, whom Tu Zichun could not forget even in his dreams.
u.src: 但它们的脸确实杜子春做梦也忘不掉的已经故去的父母的样子。

en: Hey! Why are you sitting so solemnly on Mount Emei?
u.src: “呔！你为什么端坐在峨眉山上？

en: If you do not summon workers at once, I will make your parents taste the terrors of hell too!
u.src: 如果不速速招工，本让就让你的父母也尝尝地狱的厉害！”

en: Despite being threatened like this, Du Zichun still kept his mouth shut and said nothing.
u.src: 尽管受到如此威胁，杜子春依然缄口不言。

en: You unfilial son, for your own sake, can you really be utterly indifferent even to your suffering parents?
u.src: “你这个不孝子，为了自己，难道连受苦的父母也可以毫无在乎吗？”

en: King Yama's fierce roar was deafening.
u.src: 阎罗王严厉的怒吼，震耳欲聋。

en: Demon guards, beat these two beasts!
u.src: “鬼卒们，打这两个畜生！

en: Beat them until their skin splits and their flesh is torn open!
u.src: 达到它们皮开肉绽！”

en: The demon guards answered in unison, "Yes," then took up iron whips, closed in, and mercilessly lashed the two poor, thin horses.
u.src: 鬼卒们齐声说：“是”，便拿着铁鞭围上去，对两匹可怜的瘦马毫不留情的痛下狠手。

en: The crack of the whips rang sharp and close as raindrops, leaving every place they struck covered with wounds.
u.src: 鞭声清脆，如雨点般密集，所到之处伤痕累累。

en: The parents who had been reduced to livestock, those two poor, thin horses, endured the pain as bloody tears welled up and each mournful neigh moved everyone who saw them.
u.src: 沦为牲畜的父母，两匹可怜的瘦马痛苦的忍受，血泪浮现，声声哀鸣，令人无不动容。

en: So, have you still decided not to confess?
u.src: “怎么样，你还是决定不招吗？”

en: King Yama raised his hand to signal the guards to stop, and once again urged Duzichun to speak.
u.src: 阎罗王抬手示意贵卒们停下来，在一次催促杜子春说话。

en: By this time, the two old horses were already gasping for breath and gravely wounded.
u.src: 这个时候两匹老马已经气息奄奄、受伤深重了。
“不用挂心我们。

en: We are all fine; as long as you are living well, anything is all right.
u.src: 我们都没事，只要你过得好，怎么都行。

en: No matter what the great king says, if you do not want to speak, then do not speak.
u.src: 无论大王怎么说，你不想说，就不要说。”

en: Those were the very words spoken by the mother Du Zichun had longed for day and night.
u.src: 那正是杜子春日夜思念的母亲说的话，

en: Du Zichun suddenly opened his eyes.
u.src: 杜子春突然睁开眼睛，

en: He saw a thin horse lying pitifully on the ground, its eyes full of hot tears, staring straight at him.
u.src: 看见一匹瘦马哀哀的伏在地上，满含热泪，正盯着自己看。

en: Even while struggling in such agony, the horse before him was still thinking of his suffering as a son.
u.src: 目前在这样的痛苦里挣扎，却还惦记着体谅儿子的苦衷，

en: It held no resentment even toward the guards who had beaten it.
u.src: 甚至对贵卒的殴打也没有怨恨。

en: But people in the world flatter and fawn on you when you are rich.
u.src: 但世间的人，你是大财主的时候，他们便来阿谀奉承，

en: When you are poor and ruined, they will not spare you a kind word or look.
u.src: 当你贫穷潦倒的的时候，便不假辞色。

en: Thinking of the contrast, how precious his mother's character was.
u.src: 这么一想比，母亲的品质是多么的可贵啊，

en: How firm, how utterly firm, his mother's resolve was.
u.src: 母亲的决心是多么的多么坚决！

en: Du Zichun forgot the old man's instructions.
u.src: 杜子春忘了老人家的吩咐，

en: He rolled and crawled his way over beside the horse before him.
u.src: 连滚带爬的挪到目前旁边，

en: He clasped the neck of the dying, struggling old horse tightly with both hands.
u.src: 双手紧紧抱着垂死挣扎的老马的脖子，

en: With hot tears wetting his cheeks, he cried out, Mother.
u.src: 热泪润霞，大喊一声“娘”。
